entities.name: Maria Cuțarida-Crătunescu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Maria Cuțarida-Crătunescu was the first woman to be a medical doctor in Romania. As an active feminist supporter, she founded the Maternal Society in 1897, and in 1899 organised the first crèche in Romania.
